text:
maria: Heads-up: canary rolling from merge PR#4871 is on hold — decode p95 on short seqs up ~42%. CI posted perf-failure. tagging runtime eng.

ci-bot: [perf-regression] https://ci.redwood.com/build/98765 - decode_p95_shortseq up 42% vs baseline

jacob: saw the alert. quick question: is this the attention-tile optimizer change or the async-kv serializer patch?

olga: my local profile shows a lot more thread-context-switches during KV writeback after that merge. Might be the async serializer.

samir: repro steps? I can run a canary harness.

maria: repro: checkout main@post-PR, run ./tools/canary --model tiny --seq 8 --concurrency 16
Result:
  p50: 18ms
  p95: 124ms (baseline 87ms)
  tokens/s: -18%
Attached flamegraph snippet: callstack -> async-kv-serialize -> mutex_wait

jacob: interesting — kernel-selector logs show more frequent fallback to scalar-attn for short seqs after the merge. Could be interplay between serializer pauses and kernel warmup.

olga: running perf record, sample output:
`# sample
  12.7% async_kv_serializer::flush
  9.2% thread::park
  7.0% attention_tile::compute_fused`

shyam: I started a git-bisect across commits in PR, earliest bad at 7f3c1d2 — that adds batching-window (async serializer) + new gating. bisect log: https://stash/bs/453

jacob: can we try reverting just serializer gating? if that's the culprit we should fast revert.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout paused by manual hold (maria).

samir: quick patch to throttle serializer to background thread and smaller batch seems to drop p95 back to 92ms locally. pushing PR for experiment: https://gh/redwood/patch/4890

olga: can we add additional instrumentation? add kv.serialize_ns histogram and track mutex hold time.

maria: agree. Also we should check KC (kernel cache) thrash: add metric kv_write_latency_by_seq_len.

jacob: if samir's patch is stable on canary, let's unhold after 1 hour + smoke tests. otherwise revert PR#4871.

shyam: noted. I'll run canary with patch now. will update in 15.

samir: pushed instrumented patch, starting canary run: https://ci.redwood.com/build/98790

ci-bot: perf-smoke: p95_shortseq=94ms (improved), tokens/s +3% vs held canary

maria: that's promising. canary unhold in 30m if stable. thanks all. follow-up: create task to redesign serializer to be non-blocking with KV prefetch.

jacob: I'll open follow-up RFC for serializer + kernel selector interaction.
